process_area.title: Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization

value_stream.name: Supply Chain Network Design, Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization & Flow Engineering

fields.Owner: Supply Chain Analytics (VS-28) / Network Strategy Lead
fields.Participants: BI (VS-28), Supply Planning (VS-02), DC Ops (VS-04), Logistics (VS-06)
fields.Volume: Enterprise network & inventory (~7.2M parameter sets, 205 locations)

workflows.name: Network & Inventory Performance Dashboard & KPI Monitoring

Controls: - CTL-80 (ensure inventory parameter & network optimization governance.)
- CTL-640: KPI definitions governed; data-quality monitored
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-overload risk**: Too many KPIs dilute focus; mitigated by tiered KPI hierarchy
- **Data-quality risk**: Bad data → bad decisions; mitigated by data governance (VS-28.2)
System Touchpoints: - BI (VS-28); ERP/WMS inventory (VS-05/VS-04); logistics (VS-06); MEIO outputs (W4130)

steps.activity: Analytics build the network & inventory performance dashboard: turns, inventory investment, fill rate, OTIF, stockouts, aging, cost-to-serve, by SKU/location/echelon, vs target
Supply Chain leadership review weekly/monthly, identify exceptions/trends, and trigger action or re-optimization (W4142)
Analytics tune the dashboard, ensure data quality (links to VS-28.2), and evolve metrics with maturity

fields.Participants: Supply Planning (VS-02), Inventory Lifecycle (VS-05), Merchandising (VS-01), Analytics (VS-28)

Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
Cross-references: - links to VS-05 (inventory lifecycle/accuracy), VS-01 (assortment), VS-64 (clearance), W4134 (slow-movers)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-stockout risk**: OOS not detected (lost sales); mitigated by real-time monitoring
- **Aging-creep risk**: Aging builds silently; mitigated by thresholds and action triggers

steps.activity: Supply Planning/Analytics monitor inventory health: aging buckets, dead/slow stock (links to W4134), over-stock, stockouts/OOS, and accuracy (≥97% target links to VS-05)
Supply Planning/Merchandising action on signals: expedite/rebalance on stockout (links to VS-05 transfers), clear/centralize on over-stock/aging (links to W4134/VS-64)
Supply Planning report inventory health trends, root-cause recurring issues, and feed into re-optimization (W4142) and assortment (VS-01)

fields.Participants: Supply Planning (VS-02), Logistics (VS-06), DC Ops (VS-04), CX (VS-13)
fields.Volume: All replenishment (~5,000 orders/mo), ecommerce (~42,900/mo), DC outbound

workflows.name: Fill Rate, Service Level & OTIF Performance Analytics

Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
- CTL-640: service-level targets per segment (W4131/W4132); OTIF SLA
Cross-references: - links to VS-02 (supply), VS-06 (logistics/OTIF), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-13 (CX)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lost-sale-blindness risk**: Stockouts/OOS impact not quantified; mitigated by lost-sale estimation
- **Blame-shifting risk**: Service misses not root-caused across functions; mitigated by end-to-end measurement
System Touchpoints: - Supply planning (VS-02); logistics/OTIF (VS-06); ecommerce fulfillment (VS-10); CX (VS-13); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Supply Planning/Logistics measure fill rate, line/item fill rate, service-level attainment vs target (W4131), and OTIF (on-time-in-full) for DC-to-store and ecommerce (links to VS-02/VS-06/VS-10)
Supply Planning/Logistics root-cause misses (forecast error, supply delay, picking error, routing), and act (expedite, parameter adjust W4131, lane change W4126)
Supply Planning report service performance, link to CX/complaints (VS-13) and lost-sale estimation, and feed into re-optimization (W4142)

fields.Volume: Enterprise network cost (inbound, DC, outbound, last-mile, inventory carrying)

workflows.name: Network Cost-to-Serve & Total Landed Cost Analytics

Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
- CTL-640: cost-to-serve methodology governed; reconciled to GL
Cross-references: - links to VS-110 (freight/landed cost) and W2B (import landed cost), VS-01.2/VS-101 (pricing/margin), VS-133 W4068 (cost-out)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incomplete-cost risk**: Landed cost missing components (duty, carrying, handling); mitigated by full cost-to-serve
- **Cost-blind-pricing risk**: Pricing without knowing true cost; mitigated by cost-to-serve feeding pricing
System Touchpoints: - Freight/landed cost (VS-110); finance (VS-17.4); network model (W4122); pricing (VS-01.2/VS-101)

steps.activity: Network Strategy/Finance compute cost-to-serve per SKU/location/customer/channel (inbound freight, duty, DC handling, outbound, last-mile, inventory carrying), and total landed cost (links to VS-110 freight audit and W2B import landed cost)
Network Strategy identify cost outliers and improvement opportunities (lane W4125/W4126, inventory W4136, DC W4123), and quantify impact via modeling (W4122)
Network Strategy report cost-to-serve trends, drive cost-out (links to VS-133 W4068), and feed into pricing/margin decisions (VS-01.2/VS-101)

workflows.name: Demand & Supply Variability Monitoring for Re-Optimization Triggers

Controls: - CTL-80 (ensure inventory parameter & network optimization governance.)
- CTL-640: re-optimization triggers documented; significance thresholds
Cross-references: - links to VS-127 (S&OP), VS-02.1 (demand), VS-67 (supplier), W4130 (MEIO)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-parameter risk**: Parameters not updated when variability changes; mitigated by trigger monitoring
- **Noise risk**: Reacting to random variability; mitigated by statistical-significance thresholds
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (VS-28); S&OP (VS-127); demand planning (VS-02.1); supplier scorecard (VS-67); MEIO (W4130)

steps.activity: Supply Planning/Analytics monitor demand variability (forecast error, demand pattern change) and supply variability (lead-time change, supplier reliability links to VS-67) per SKU/echelon
Supply Planning detect re-optimization triggers (variability breach, new product ramp, supplier change, seasonality shift), and route to the refresh cycle (W4142)
Supply Planning feed variability insights to S&OP (VS-127) and demand planning (VS-02.1), and report trend

workflows.name: Network & Inventory Re-Optimization Cycle & Parameter Refresh

Automation Opportunity: - End-to-end re-optimization pipeline (data → MEIO → MDM → validation)
Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
- CTL-640: parameter refresh governed (W4135); post-refresh validation
Cross-references: - links to VS-29 MDM-021 (parameters), VS-02 (replenishment), VS-134 (OCM), W4130/W4131 (optimization)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Skipped-refresh risk**: Cycle slips, parameters stale; mitigated by scheduled cadence and triggers (W4141)
- **Disruptive-change risk**: Big parameter swings disrupt operations; mitigated by phasing and change management (VS-134)
System Touchpoints: - MEIO (W4130); MDM (VS-29 MDM-021); ERP replenishment (VS-02); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Network Strategy/Supply Planning run the scheduled re-optimization cycle: re-run MEIO (W4130) and safety-stock/ROP optimization (W4131) on latest demand/lead-time data, and review segmentation (W4132)
steps.r: Network Strategy Lead / Supply Planning / Analytics

steps.activity: Network Strategy/Supply Planning publish refreshed parameters to MDM (W4135) with effective-dating and approval, and communicate changes to planning/DC/store
Network Strategy validate post-refresh performance (W4137/W4139), capture lessons, and refine the optimization models

fields.Trigger: Network decision; resilience review; major disruption

workflows.name: Simulation, Digital Twin & Network Stress Testing

Automation Opportunity: - Scenario library; automated stress-test runs; calibration from actuals
Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
- CTL-640: stress-test scenarios reviewed by Risk/BCP; results feed resilience design
Cross-references: - links to VS-21.2 (ERM), VS-26 (BCP), VS-69 (typhoon), VS-02.3 (disruption), W4127 (resilience)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Model-validity risk**: Simulation diverges from reality; mitigated by calibration to actuals and events
- **Unprepared risk**: Scenarios never tested; mitigated by routine stress-testing
System Touchpoints: - Simulation/digital-twin platform; network model (W4122); risk register (VS-21.2); BCP (VS-26); typhoon (VS-69)

steps.activity: Network Strategy/Analytics build/maintain a network digital twin / simulation (demand, supply, inventory, lanes, capacity) for stress-testing scenarios
Network Strategy/Risk stress-test: DC outage, port closure, supplier failure, typhoon (links to VS-69), demand surge (links to VS-02.3 W1187), and quantify service/cost/working-capital impact
Network Strategy use results to design resilience (W4127), validate BCP (VS-26), and report stress-test findings to risk governance (VS-21.2/VS-26)

fields.Owner: VP Supply Chain / Network Strategy Lead
fields.Participants: Executive team, Merchandising (VS-01), Finance (VS-17.4), Risk (VS-21.2), Board (VS-36)

Controls: - CTL-640 (ensure controlled execution — Network & Inventory Performance Analytics, Simulation & Continuous Re-Optimization (PA-136.3).)
- CTL-640: annual review with Board oversight (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy/performance), VS-36 (governance), VS-01 (merchandising), VS-17.4 (finance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stagnation risk**: Network/inventory practice plateaus; mitigated by maturity assessment and benchmarking
- **Misalignment risk**: Network strategy drifts from corporate strategy; mitigated by annual strategic alignment

steps.activity: Network Strategy assess network/inventory performance vs strategy (turns, service, cost-to-serve, resilience), maturity of the optimization practice, and benchmark externally
Network Strategy review the annual program: outcomes (W4137–W4140), refresh effectiveness (W4142), resilience (W4127/W4143), and the forward plan
Network Strategy present to the Board (VS-36), set next-year targets, and adjust strategy/operating model
